stories.title: 15 birds euthanized in Manitoba over avian flu concerns, carcasses left overnight
stories.summary: Conservation officials in Manitoba have euthanized 15 wild birds suspected of having avian flu, though some could not be immediately removed from the area.

stories.title: Connor’s three-point night propels Winnipeg Jets to 4-2 win in Boston
stories.summary: Kyle Connor scored his 20th goal in Winnipeg's 26th game of the season and added a couple of helpers as the Jets improved to 9-1-1 in their last 11 games.

stories.title: Winnipeg Blue Bombers re-sign 4 pending free agents
stories.summary: The Bombers completed deals with Jake Kelly, Michael Chris-Ike, Michael Ayers, and Micah Vanterpool.

stories.title: Workers at Manitoba disability support non-profit vote for strike mandate: MGEU
stories.summary: Employees represented by the MGEU at Manitoba Possible voted in favour of a strike mandate after contract talks with its employer stalled.

stories.title: Police searching for truck suspected in fatal Winnipeg hit-and-run
stories.summary: Winnipeg police are searching for a pickup truck investigators believe is connected to a hit-and-run that left a 32-year-old man dead.

stories.title: Manitoba urged to continue work on wildfire response after devastating 2025 season
stories.summary: A new report examined how Manitoba can improve its wildfire response, after millions of hectares burned in the summer of 2025.

stories.title: Vilardi nets hat trick as Winnipeg Jets cap homestand with 4-2 win over Mammoth
stories.summary: Gabriel Vilardi completed his second career hat trick into an empty net while Stuart Skinner made 34 saves as the Mammoth outshot the Jets 36-15.

stories.title: Lions coach Pierce signs extension through 2029
Manitoba solar panel project could create 8,000 jobs, First Nations group says
stories.summary: A new solar panel manufacturing facility may soon come to Manitoba, following a memorandum of understanding between the Southern Chiefs Organization and RCT Solutions.

stories.title: Winnipeg Blue Bombers sign linebacker Jacob Roberts to one-year contract
stories.summary: The Winnipeg Blue Bombers signed Jacob Roberts, the six-foot-one, 233-pound American linebacker to a one-year contract Monday.
